args.title: Fix weekly scheduled export sending starting one week late
args.body:
File: src/export/scheduler.ts

Adjust the calculation of nextRunAt for weekly cadence to correctly schedule the export on the intended day, rather than always adding 7 days regardless of the current time. This fixes the bug where a weekly scheduled export created earlier on the run day does not send until the following week.
